definitions.gloss: to critique; to review; to comment critically
definitions.explanation: To analyze and evaluate something, especially works of art, literature, politics, or social issues, offering informed opinions and judgments.
A critical essay or commentary, especially one dealing with literature, art, or current affairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{評論|ひょうろん}した。
⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{評論|ひょうろん}する⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important not just to critique politics but to take action.

examples.english: He has been sharply critiquing social issues for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ている→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Her critiques have gained support from many readers.

notes:
Implies thoughtful, informed analysis rather than casual opinion. Used in intellectual, literary, and media contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧: literary criticism
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧: social commentary
- ⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: critical work; writing reviews
- ⟦{評論|ひょうろん}{家|か}→評論家：16405_hyouronka⟧: critic; commentator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧: criticism; review — very close synonym, slightly more focused on judging quality
- ⟦{論評|ろんぴょう}→論評：18443_ronpyou⟧: review; commentary — more formal, often in newspapers
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: criticism — carries a stronger negative connotation
- ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧: impressions — much more casual and personal
